rows.quote: For the current investigation, the R8 release of results of genome-wide association analysis was utilized, which encompassed 39,036 CAD cases (defined by the code 410|4110 in International Classification of Diseases (ICD)-Eighth Revision and the code 410|4110 in ICD-Ninth Revisions and the code I20.0, I21, or I22 in ICD-Tenth Revision) and 303,463 non-cases.
